metadata.title: install windows updates at given date and time
metadata.description:
Download and install windows updates on remote computer at given date and time.

Script generates available windows updates list on remote computer.
Allows to exclude individual KB.
Sets sheduled job on remote computer to do the task.
After execution writes log to remote computer c:\temp\windows-updates-install-log.txt.

Script is written using Windows Update Agent API.
https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa387099(v=vs.85).aspx

usage:

.\windows-updater-using-WUA-API.ps1 -computer <servername> 

.\windows-updater-using-WUA-API.ps1 -computer <servername> -excludelist 3140250, 3140234 -includeoptionalupdates -rebootifrequired
